title: Stative vs Dynamic Verbs (or Non-action vs Action Verbs) - Verb Types

explanation.en: The verb 'know' is a stative verb that describes a mental state and cannot be used in continuous form.
explanation.ru: Глагол 'know' - это статичный глагол, который описывает ментальное состояние и не может использоваться в продолженном времени.
explanation.uz: 'Know' fe'li holat fe'li bo'lib, aqliy holatni tasvirlaydi va davomiy zamonda ishlatilmaydi.

options.answer: She is having a beautiful voice.

explanation.en: The verb 'have' when expressing possession is a stative verb and is not used in continuous form.
explanation.ru: Глагол 'have' при выражении владения является статичным глаголом и не используется в продолженной форме.
explanation.uz: 'Have' fe'li egalik ma'nosida ishlatilganda holat fe'li hisoblanadi va davomiy shaklda ishlatilmaydi.

explanation.en: The verb 'believe' is a stative verb that expresses opinion or mental state and cannot be used in continuous form.
explanation.ru: Глагол 'believe' - это статичный глагол, выражающий мнение или ментальное состояние, и не может использоваться в продолженной форме.
explanation.uz: 'Believe' fe'li fikr yoki aqliy holatni bildiruvchi holat fe'li bo'lib, davomiy shaklda ishlatilmaydi.

explanation.en: When 'smell' describes an active quality of something, it can be used in continuous form with proper auxiliary verb 'is'.
explanation.ru: Когда 'smell' описывает активное качество чего-то, он может использоваться в продолженной форме с правильным вспомогательным глаголом 'is'.
explanation.uz: 'Smell' fe'li biror narsaning faol xususiyatini tasvirlaganda, to'g'ri yordamchi fe'l 'is' bilan davomiy shaklda ishlatilishi mumkin.

explanation.en: The verb 'understand' is a stative verb that describes mental comprehension and is not used in continuous form.
explanation.ru: Глагол 'understand' - это статичный глагол, описывающий ментальное понимание, и не используется в продолженной форме.
explanation.uz: 'Understand' fe'li aqliy tushunishni tasvirlovchi holat fe'li bo'lib, davomiy shaklda ishlatilmaydi.

explanation.en: The verb 'play' is a dynamic verb that describes an action and can be used in continuous form with 'are'.
explanation.ru: Глагол 'play' - это динамичный глагол, описывающий действие, и может использоваться в продолженной форме с 'are'.
explanation.uz: 'Play' fe'li harakatni tasvirlovchi dinamik fe'l bo'lib, 'are' bilan davomiy shaklda ishlatilishi mumkin.

explanation.en: The verb 'need' is a stative verb that expresses necessity and is not used in continuous form.
explanation.ru: Глагол 'need' - это статичный глагол, выражающий необходимость, и не используется в продолженной форме.
explanation.uz: 'Need' fe'li zaruriyatni bildiruvchi holat fe'li bo'lib, davomiy shaklda ishlatilmaydi.

explanation.en: The verb 'love' when expressing emotion is a stative verb and cannot be used in continuous form.
explanation.ru: Глагол 'love' при выражении эмоции является статичным глаголом и не может использоваться в продолженной форме.
explanation.uz: 'Love' fe'li hissiyot ma'nosida ishlatilganda holat fe'li hisoblanadi va davomiy shaklda ishlatilmaydi.

explanation.en: The verb 'belong' is a stative verb that expresses possession or relationship and is not used in continuous form.

explanation.uz: 'Belong' fe'li egalik yoki munosabatni bildiruvchi holat fe'li bo'lib, davomiy shaklda ishlatilmaydi.

prompt.en: Fill in the blanks with the correct words

items.text: Sarah is a university student who ___1___ (love) learning new languages. Right now, she ___2___ (sit) in the library and ___3___ (study) for her Spanish exam. She ___4___ (know) that languages are important for her future career. The library is quiet, and she ___5___ (hear) only the sound of pages turning. Sarah ___6___ (believe) that practice makes perfect, so she ___7___ (write) vocabulary words in her notebook at this moment. She ___8___ (want) to become fluent in Spanish by next year. Her friend Maria ___9___ (help) her with pronunciation when they meet. Sarah ___10___ (think) Maria is an excellent teacher because she ___11___ (have) native-level Spanish skills. The textbook ___12___ (contain) many useful exercises that Sarah ___13___ (do) every day. She ___14___ (understand) that consistent practice is the key to success, and she ___15___ (feel) confident about her progress.

explanation.en: This exercise demonstrates the difference between stative verbs (love, know, hear, believe, want, think, have, contain, understand, feel) which express states and are not used in continuous form, and dynamic verbs (sit, study, write, help, do) which express actions and can be used in continuous form.
explanation.ru: Это упражнение демонстрирует разницу между статичными глаголами (love, know, hear, believe, want, think, have, contain, understand, feel), которые выражают состояния и не используются в продолженной форме, и динамичными глаголами (sit, study, write, help, do), которые выражают действия и могут использоваться в продолженной форме.
explanation.uz: Bu mashq holat fe'llari (love, know, hear, believe, want, think, have, contain, understand, feel) va dinamik fe'llar (sit, study, write, help, do) o'rtasidagi farqni ko'rsatadi. Holat fe'llari holatni bildiradi va davomiy shaklda ishlatilmaydi, dinamik fe'llar esa harakatni bildiradi va davomiy shaklda ishlatilishi mumkin.

prompt.en: Fill in the blanks with the correct words

items.text: Tom ___1___ (work) as a chef in a busy restaurant downtown. He ___2___ (enjoy) his job very much because he ___3___ (love) cooking creative dishes. Right now, it's lunch time and Tom ___4___ (prepare) several meals simultaneously. The kitchen ___5___ (smell) wonderful with all the different aromas. Tom ___6___ (know) all the recipes by heart, but he still ___7___ (check) them carefully. His assistant Jake ___8___ (cut) vegetables while Tom ___9___ (cook) the main course. The restaurant ___10___ (belong) to Tom's uncle, who ___11___ (trust) Tom completely. Customers ___12___ (wait) patiently for their food because they ___13___ (understand) that good food takes time. Tom ___14___ (feel) proud when people compliment his cooking, and he ___15___ (hope) to open his own restaurant someday.

explanation.en: This passage contrasts stative verbs expressing permanent states, emotions, and mental processes (work, enjoy, love, smell, know, belong, trust, understand, feel, hope) with dynamic verbs describing ongoing actions (prepare, check, cut, cook, wait).
explanation.ru: Этот отрывок контрастирует статичные глаголы, выражающие постоянные состояния, эмоции и ментальные процессы (work, enjoy, love, smell, know, belong, trust, understand, feel, hope) с динамичными глаголами, описывающими продолжающиеся действия (prepare, check, cut, cook, wait).
explanation.uz: Bu matn doimiy holatlar, hissiyotlar va aqliy jarayonlarni ifodalovchi holat fe'llari (work, enjoy, love, smell, know, belong, trust, understand, feel, hope) bilan davom etayotgan harakatlarni tasvirlovchi dinamik fe'llar (prepare, check, cut, cook, wait) o'rtasidagi farqni ko'rsatadi.
